arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse_policy
from compiler.compiler import compile_policy

names = ['A'] + ['X%d'%i for i in range(1,16)]
order = names
idx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(order)}
words = []
for i in range(4096):
    w = [names[i//256], names[1 + (i%256)//16], names[1 + (i%16)]] + [names[1]]*13
    words.append(w)
pol = ''.join('match(%s) allow;' % ','.join(w) for w in words)
print('policy bytes', len(pol))
t=time.time(); rules, a, p = parse_policy(pol); print('parse', round(time.time()-t,3), a, p)
t=time.time(); acc, rows, cells = compile_policy(rules, order, idx); print('compile', round(time.time()-t,3), 'rows', len(rows), 'cells', cells)
PYEOF
